scenes.heading: Confirm the time and policy in writing first

sents.d: Confirm the time and policy in writing first
Before your first session, get the time and your cancellation policy confirmed in writing.
A written record prevents arguments over missed sessions.
And it makes your policy easier to enforce without awkwardness.
After booking, email the session time, time zone and cancellation terms.
Ask the client to reply and acknowledge it before your first call.

take: Get the session time and policy confirmed in writing before the first call.
